t: Time 3183Y white flexible cable delivers robust performance for washing machines and tumble dryers. This 10m coil features a heavy-duty 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The substantial 2.5mm² conductor area safely handles the high current demands of major domestic appliances, whilst the PVC sheath maintains reliability between -15°C and 70°C. With 48 strands per core, the cable provides exceptional flexibility for secure connections and convenient routing in demanding laundry applications.
b: Suitable for Washing Machines & Tumble Dryers
